target_customer: B2B SaaS startups and growing software companies that need authentication with organizations, roles and enterprise SSO
problem: B2B products need team accounts, invitations, roles and SSO, which generic auth tools handle poorly and take months to build.
business_model: Usage and seat-based SaaS pricing for hosted authentication
product_category: Authentication and user management for B2B software

founders.name: Andrew Israel
founders.background_notes: YC page: over 10 years building software and leading teams.

competitors.name: Clerk
competitors.funding_then: Series A of $15M came in March 2023, after the batch

competitors.name: WorkOS
competitors.what: Enterprise SSO and directory sync API

technical_complexity.rationale: Security sensitive auth plus SAML and SSO support is standard but demanding for a solo founder.

defensibility.rationale: Auth is deeply integrated and painful to migrate, but several funded rivals sell similar products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying of PropelAuth found; competitors kept raising later rounds.

market_need_then: In 2022 B2B SaaS teams needed organizations and SSO from day one. Launch HN post drew 26 points and 14 comments in March 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer-focused; says a great auth product gets out of your way

brand_strength.rationale: Clear developer niche positioning, no evidence of brand-led growth.

pivots.why: Founder said in a Product Hunt comment the company narrowed to B2B customers; date not found.

outcome_analysis: PropelAuth raised a $2.59M seed in July 2022 after the W22 batch and still operates with a B2B auth niche serving thousands of businesses per its site. No later priced round was found, so it may be capital efficient or simply unreported.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog and two outlets. Investor lists vary by outlet. CB Insights also shows a convertible note in March 2022 and $3.09M total, not recorded. A search says founders include Tyler Johnson and Stephen Campbell, but no opened source lists them; not recorded. Competitor sources are undated comparison pages; Clerk's Series A is after the batch. Searches found no acquisition, layoffs or shutdown.
